description: Where the debugged game is stopped. The errors and warnings a game reported are in editor_output. evaluate runs what the expression calls, so a call that changes something changes the game. Operations: stack: the stack trace; variables: locals, members and globals at a frame, with their values; evaluate (needs expression): what an expression evaluates to at a frame, run in the stopped game, the first loading every global class; output: console output from the debug adapter. Default stack.

expression.description: A GDScript expression with self's members, locals, autoloads and global classes in scope, such as wave.spawned[0] or Ledger.entries.size(). For op evaluate.

frameId.description: Which frame, from a stack answer. Default the innermost. For ops variables, evaluate.

name: debug_state
title: Debugger state
